subject: Kiln Payments: Chat streaming severe latency - immediate mitigation & next steps
messages:
From: Tim Bruner <tim.bruner@kilnpayments.com>
To: ava_chen@redwood.example
Cc: support@kilnpayments.com
Date: Tue, 14 Feb 2028 15:32:10 -0800
Subject: Severe latency on chat stream - production outage?

Hi Ava —

We started seeing our live-chat bots intermittently stall and then emit long token bursts this afternoon (starting ~15:20 PT). Customers report 10–30s gaps between the last visible token and the continuation. This is affecting checkout support flows.

Attached is a short screencap and a small list of request IDs from one affected session (request_ids_0214.txt). Example request id: rq_3f9b2d. Our engineers see the same in our client logs: connection stays open but bytes stop for up to 20s before a multi-token flush.

Can Redwood confirm whether there’s an incident on streaming endpoints? If there’s a recommended immediate config change on our side to reduce impact while you triage, please advise — we’re prepared to patch mid-deployment if needed.

Thanks — huge impact for a number of live conversations.

—Tim
Tim Bruner
Head of Support Engineering, Kiln Payments
From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.example>
To: Tim Bruner <tim.bruner@kilnpayments.com>
Cc: dev_patel@redwood.example, grace_oconnor@redwood.example, sergio_alvarez@redwood.example
Date: Tue, 14 Feb 2028 15:40:23 -0800
Subject: Re: Severe latency on chat stream - production outage?

Hi Tim — thanks for the quick heads-up and the attachments, that was really helpful. We’re seeing alerts that match the timestamps you provided. I’ve escalated to infra and the serving runtime team and cc’d them here.

Short-term mitigations you can apply immediately (no code redeploy required in most cases):
- Switch to non-streaming polling for the most critical routes: set stream=false and poll for full response (this removes perceived stutter).
- Reduce max_tokens for the prompt/response window (try cutting max_tokens by 30%).
- If you can, temporarily route to a smaller, lower-latency model variant (e.g. \"redwood-1-small\") while we triage.
- If you use our SDK, add a fallback header to prefer polling when streaming stalls (example below).

SDK example (conceptual):
// Node pseudo
const res = await redwood.chat.create({
  model: 'redwood-1',
  stream: false,
  max_tokens: 128,
  headers: { 'x-redwood-fallback': 'polling' }
});

If you want us to make a short-term pin on your tenant (route override to reduce cross-shard fanout), we can do that immediately — please confirm and we’ll apply for a 2-hour window while we root cause.

I will post a shared action tracker for this incident and we’ll send a more detailed update within 90 minutes.

—Ava
Ava Chen
AM — Customer Success, Redwood Inference
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.example>
To: ava_chen@redwood.example, Tim Bruner <tim.bruner@kilnpayments.com>
Cc: grace_oconnor@redwood.example, sergio_alvarez@redwood.example
Date: Tue, 14 Feb 2028 15:55:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Severe latency on chat stream - production outage?

Hi all — quick notes from initial infra triage:

What we’re seeing (preliminary):
- A routing regression at the autoscaler caused a subset of requests to be routed across a cross-region proxy pool, increasing inter-node tail latency and causing token flush coalescing.
- The serving runtime’s prefix cache miss rate spiked for sequences with long context windows (your logs show long histories).

Immediate actions we’ve applied (server-side):
- Applied a tenant-level route pin to us-west-2 for Kiln Payments to avoid cross-region hops (active now).
- Warmed prefix caches on the affected shard and increased the KV-cache retention temporarily.
- Increased the streaming heartbeat timeout to 10s to reduce transient disconnects.

Suggested customer-side configuration (fastest to apply):
- Temporarily disable streaming where latency is user-visible (stream=false), or add short poll interval if you already poll.
- Send shorter conversation windows (truncate beyond 4k tokens).
- Add retry logic on empty-stream gaps of 3–5s to request poll fallback.

We’ll continue to monitor the pinned route. I’ll post another update when we have the RCA.

Attachments: incident_quick_triage_checklist.pdf (quick steps we shared with SRE).

—Dev
Dev Patel
Senior Software Engineer, Serving Runtime — Redwood Inference
From: Tim Bruner <tim.bruner@kilnpayments.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.example>
Cc: dev_patel@redwood.example, grace_oconnor@redwood.example, sergio_alvarez@redwood.example, support@kilnpayments.com
Date: Tue, 14 Feb 2028 17:10:05 -0800
Subject: Re: Severe latency on chat stream - production outage?

Ava/Dev —

Confirming: after you pinned the route and we temporarily switched our highest-risk endpoints to polling, stalls dropped to near-zero and customer effects are resolved. Thank you for the fast response.

Request: we’d like your post-incident report (RCA and timeline) and confirmation on any tenant-level changes that persist. Also please let us know if there’s any credits/contract relief you can offer given the impact window.

I’ve attached a short clip (screencap_stream_stall_0214.png) — happy to forward more logs if useful.

Thanks again — Tim
